gloss: to put on and take off; to attach and detach

definitions.gloss: to put on and take off; to attach and detach
definitions.explanation: The action of attaching/putting on and removing/taking off, especially clothing, accessories, or detachable parts. Often describes the ease or method of the process.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ジャケット→ジャケット：04522_jaketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{着脱|ちゃくだつ}→着脱：19966_chakudatsu⟧しやすい。
examples.english: This jacket is easy to put on and take off.

examples.japanese: ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着脱|ちゃくだつ}→着脱：19966_chakudatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{清潔|せいけつ}→清潔：01583_seiketsu⟧な⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}って→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put on and remove your mask with clean hands.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着脱|ちゃくだつ}→着脱：19966_chakudatsu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: This camera's lens can be easily attached and detached, which is convenient.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (put on/attach) and {脱|だつ} (take off/remove). Used both for clothing and for detachable parts/accessories. The noun form ⟦{着脱|ちゃくだつ}→着脱：19966_chakudatsu⟧ is common in product descriptions where ease of use is a selling point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{着脱|ちゃくだつ}→着脱：19966_chakudatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧: easy to put on/take off
- ⟦{着脱|ちゃくだつ}→着脱：19966_chakudatsu⟧しやすい: easy to attach/detach
- ⟦{着脱|ちゃくだつ}→着脱：19966_chakudatsu⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: detachable; removable
- {着脱式|ちゃくだつしき}: detachable type
- ワンタッチ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{着脱|ちゃくだつ}→着脱：19966_chakudatsu⟧: attach/detach with one touch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧/⟦{脱|ぬ}ぐ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧: to put on/take off (clothing) — the individual verbs for each action
- ⟦{取|と}り{外|はず}す→取り外す：06161_torihazusu⟧: to remove; to detach — for removing a specific part
- ⟦{装着|そうちゃく}する→装着する：22176_souchakusuru⟧: to wear; to equip — focuses on the attaching/equipping action only
